title: Director Solutions Platform, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><h3><strong>Role Purpose</strong></h3> <p>The Platform Operations Director is responsible for ensuring that solutions developed and released for the Solutions team are operationally ready, properly tested, clearly documented, effectively released, and provide support once live.</p> <p>The role acts as the bridge between delivery, business readiness and BAU operations. It supports the transition of work from project delivery into stable operational use, ensuring that users, stakeholders and support teams understand what has changed, how to use it, how to raise issues, and how ongoing support will be managed with appropriate priority, impact and SLAs</p> <p>This role is particularly important as Solutions Integration moves from a more reactive service model into a structured product and agile delivery function. The Platform Operations Director owns QA, release management, documentation, stakeholder communication, support processes, training, adoption and post-release improvement including BAU bugs and triage.</p> <p>The role works closely with Product Owners, Scrum Master, Engineering, Data, Reporting, QA, Platform Operations, and business stakeholders to make sure delivery does not stop at “built”, but continues through testing, launch, adoption, support and measurable operational value.</p> <h2><strong>Senior / Specialist-Level Expectations</strong></h2> <p>As a Director within the team, this role is expected to help define and improve the operating standards around BAU management, QA coordination, release readiness, business readiness and service transition. Manage and proactively manage risk, resolution SLAs and ensure we are adhering to platform operational best practices.</p> <p>The Platform Operations Director should be able to identify operational risks early, challenge whether a solution is genuinely ready for release, and recommend practical improvements to processes, documentation, testing, support models and stakeholder communications.</p> <p>For smaller initiatives, the role should be able to advise Product Owners and delivery teams on the appropriate level of QA, training, release planning, handover and BAU support required. For larger or more complex initiatives, the role should escalate risks, dependencies or readiness gaps to the Product Manager Lead, Scrum Master, Lead Engineer / Solutions Architect or relevant leadership stakeholders.</p> <h1><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h1> <h2><strong>1. BAU Operations Management</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own and coordinate BAU operational processes for assigned platforms, tools, reports, workflows and solutions across all Media solutions.</li> <li>Monitor recurring issues, support trends, operational risks and user pain points.</li> <li>Triage and prioritise BAU requests, incidents, defects and enhancement requests.</li> <li>Ensure BAU work is captured through the agreed intake and backlog process rather than unmanaged emails, verbal requests or fragmented ticket routes.</li> <li>Work with Product Owners and the Scrum Master to distinguish between BAU support, defects, enhancements and new product requirements.</li> <li>Maintain visibility of BAU demand and help identify where recurring issues should become product improvements or engineering fixes.</li> <li>Support continuous improvement of support processes, documentation and operational workflows.</li> </ul> <p>This links directly to the team’s wider shift away from fragmented request routes and towards clearer delivery rhythms, structured backlogs and improved operational process discipline. The existing documentation notes the need for clearer team rhythms, sprint cadences, retrospectives and mentoring as part of the transition plan .</p> <h2><strong>2. QA Coordination and Testing Readiness</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Coordinate QA activity across delivery workstreams, ensuring testing requirements are understood before development begins.</li> <li>Work with Product Owners to ensure acceptance criteria, test scenarios and success measures are clearly defined.</li> <li>Support test planning across functional testing, regression testing, data validation, reporting checks and user acceptance testing.</li> <li>Ensure defects are logged, prioritised, tracked and resolved through the agreed delivery process.</li> <li>Work with engineers, analysts and business users to validate that solutions meet functional, operational and reporting requirements.</li> <li>Support the creation of reusable QA checklists, test scripts and validation templates.</li> <li>Ensure solutions are not released without appropriate testing evidence and business sign-off.</li> </ul> <p>This is consistent with the Product Owner responsibilities already defined around testing requirements, success criteria, UAT coordination, business validation, release readiness and operational handover . The Platform Operations Specialist would support and operationalise those activities.</p> <h2><strong>3. Business Readiness and Adoption</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ensure business users and operational teams are ready to adopt new or changed solutions.</li> <li>Coordinate training, guidance, demos, FAQs, release notes and user communications.</li> <li>Work with Product Owners to identify impacted teams, users, processes and workflows.</li> <li>Confirm that business teams understand what is changing, why it is changing, when it is happening and what action is required.</li> <li>Support stakeholder communications before, during and after release.</li> <li>Gather early feedback from users and ensure issues are captured and prioritised appropriately.</li> <li>Help ensure delivered solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations, rather than remaining underused or misunderstood.</li> </ul> <p>The handover documentation highlights the importance of clear communication with users, proper release notes, demonstrations and adoption support for new features and solutions . This role should own the operational discipline around making that happen consistently.</p> <h2><strong>4. Release Readiness and Service Transition</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own or coordinate release readiness checklists for assigned solutions.</li> <li>Ensure each release has appropriate testing evidence, documentation, support ownership, training material and stakeholder communication.</li> <li>Coordinate operational handover from delivery teams into BAU support.</li> <li>Confirm that runbooks, troubleshooting guides, known issues and escalation routes are in place.</li> <li>Work with engineering and data teams to ensure monitoring, alerting or manual checks are defined where required.</li> <li>Support go-live planning, release scheduling and post-release hypercare.</li> <li>Track post-release issues and ensure learnings are fed back into future delivery cycles.</li> </ul> <p>This role should become the person asking:</p> <p>“Are we actually ready to put this live, support it, explain it, and measure whether it worked?”</p> <h2><strong>5. Documentation and Knowledge Management</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Maintain clear operational documentation for platforms, reports, tools, processes and workflows.</li> <li>Support the creation of user guides, SOPs, runbooks, release notes, FAQs and support documentation.</li> <li>Ensure documentation is stored in the agreed location and kept up to date.</li> <li>Work with Product Owners, engineers and analysts to document key dependencies, business rules, known limitations and support processes.</li> <li>Help reduce reliance on individual knowledge by making processes and system behaviour transparent.</li> <li>Support onboarding of new team members by maintaining accessible knowledge resources.</li> </ul> <p>This is important because the team is moving away from legacy ways of working and informal knowledge transfer into a more structured operating model.</p> <h2><strong>6. Platform and Process Governance</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Support the consistent use of agreed tools, workflows, ticketing processes and delivery governance.</li> <li>Help ensure work is captured, categorised and progressed through the correct routes.</li> <li>Maintain standards for BAU tickets, defects, release requests, support issues and operational change.</li> <li>Identify process gaps, duplicated effort or inconsistent ways of working.</li> <li>Recommend improvements to BAU processes, support models, QA standards and release governance.</li> <li>Support reporting on operational performance, support demand, defect trends and release readiness.</li> <li>Help ensure changes are controlled, documented and aligned to agreed team practices.</li> </ul> <p>This aligns with the documented need to improve proactive behaviour, structured product management, backlog grooming, stand-ups and retrospectives across the team .</p> <h2><strong>7. Stakeholder and Cross-Team Coordination</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Data, Reporting, QA, Scrum Master and business users.</li> <li>Coordinate with Activation, Operations, Channel Development, Commercial and other impacted teams where relevant.</li> <li>Ensure operational dependencies are understood and managed before release.</li> <li>Help stakeholders understand support routes, known issues, timelines and release impacts.</li> <li>Escalate operational risks, unresolved defects, readiness gaps or business adoption concerns.</li> <li>Support regular BAU and platform operations updates for leadership where required.</li> </ul> <p>The existing Product Owner documentation already describes the importance of coordination across engineering, data, reporting, platform, operations and business teams . The Platform Operations Specialist should provide the operational control layer that supports this.</p> <p> </p> <h1><strong> </strong></h1> <h1><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></h1> <h2><strong>Essential</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in platform operations, service transition, QA coordination, business readiness,

Reporting directly to the VP/Head of Strategy & Comms Planning, you will take operational charge of the planning floor, transforming upstream business logic into world-class, insight-led comms strategies that inspire both creative agency partners and senior client marketers.</p> <p>This role is purpose-built to transform our day-to-day strategic craft. get them using the data at our fingertips, always looking beyond TGI! </li> <li>Instill Strategic Confidence: Build a team culture anchored in conviction, strategic bravery, and clear point-of-view, empowering planners to defend ideas and challenge client briefs with commercial intelligence.</li> </ul> </ol> <p><strong>Candidate Profile & Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Senior Comms Planning clout:</strong> Experience in senior Comms Strategy/planning, Connections Planning, or Integrated Strategy roles within top-tier media or creative agencies.</li> <li><strong>Master Storyteller</strong>: Exceptional ability to distill messy, highly technical, and data-dense inputs into elegant, high-impact stories tailored for CMOs and Marketing Directors.</li> <li><strong>Insight Hunter</strong>: Demonstrated ability to find provocative, emotionally resonant human truths and cultural tensions that unlock fresh creative media solutions, not just reporting what the data says, but proving why it matters.</li> <li><strong>Creative Fluency</strong>: Experienced working alongside top creative agency strategy leads, with the diplomacy, creative vocabulary, and collaborative skill to shape work jointly.</li> <li><strong>B2C & B2B Versatility:</strong> Consumer comms experience combined with the intellectual curiosity and agility to tackle the complex, account-based nuances of BT Business.</li> <li><strong>Team Player: </strong>Natural mentor who loves developing planners, raising team morale through their positivity, enthusiasm and energy, to support building an environment of strategic excellence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. How? By being able to create a holistic measurement framework relevant for your brand and applicable to every campaign that is digestible (setting KPI’s methods I.e., which tool/system, necessary tracking) and plan for adaptation/optimisation</li> <li>You are confident in presenting with passion and conviction, managing senior client relationships, running all agency team sessions and collaboratively leading client projects and tackling challenging conversations.</li> <li>You are excited to work as part of a team; immediate, wider department and specialists as required. title: Senior Principal Solution Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Strength in Trust </h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong>The Challenge</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Principal Solutions Engineer to shape and lead technical strategy for OneTrust’s most strategic and complex opportunities in the UK & Ireland. Reporting to the Solutions Engineering Manager, you will bring broad portfolio fluency, deep enterprise technology expertise, executive-level customer engagement, and commercial judgement to help customers solve business-critical challenges with OneTrust.</p> <p>You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and partners to build deep account alignment, progress complex buying decisions, and create measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You will be a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders and a force multiplier for the Solutions Engineering organisation: setting s high bar, developing reusable approaches, and coaching others to raise the quality of our work. AI Governance is an important area of expertise for this role, alongside the breadth to lead opportunities across OneTrust’s entire platform.</p> <h3><strong>Your Mission</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead technical strategy for the highest-impact, most complex opportunities across OneTrust’s solutions portfolio, aligning the customer’s business priorities, technology environment, risk posture, architecture and decision process to the right OneTrust solutions and measurable outcomes. Bring particular depth in AI Governance where relevant to the customer’s needs.</li> <li>Build deep account alignment with Account Executives, Customer Success and other partners. Map the buying group and executive sponsors; understand account priorities and whitespace; and shape a coordinated, multi-stakeholder motion that advances the opportunity and contributes to sustainable ACV growth. Partner with the commercial account owners on expansion strategy; this role does not replace their ownership of the customer relationship.</li> <li>Engage credibly with executive and practitioner stakeholders—including CIO/CTO, CISO, Chief AI and Data leaders, Privacy, Legal, Risk, Security, Procurement, and AI/ML Engineering—to connect governance requirements with business value and delivery realities.</li> <li>Lead discovery and solution design for complex enterprise programmes across relevant OneTrust solution areas, translating fragmented requirements, regulatory obligations and technical constraints into practical, scalable operating models, architectures and workflows.</li> <li>Bring deep technical expertise in OneTrust’s solutions, enterprise integrations and the technology ecosystems relevant to each opportunity. Advise on APIs, data flows, identity and access, cloud and platform architecture, and—where relevant—AI/ML lifecycles and operational controls; identify risks and dependencies early; and recommend implementable designs.</li> <li>Lead tailored demonstrations, technical evaluations, proofs of concept, RFP responses and executive presentations across the portfolio. Set clear success criteria, prove technical fit and business value, and use evaluation outcomes to build stakeholder confidence and progress the sales motion.</li> <li>Articulate OneTrust’s differentiated value and position solutions thoughtfully against alternatives, connecting customer requirements to the most relevant solution capabilities, integrations and roadmap—including AI Governance where applicable—without overpromising.</li> <li>Act as a strategic bridge between the field and Product, Engineering, Marketing and leadership. Bring structured customer and competitive insight to inform product direction, positioning, packaging and go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Create reusable solution patterns, account-planning practices, demos, technical guidance and field assets that improve consistency and outcomes beyond an individual opportunity.</li> <li>Coach and mentor Solutions Engineers and cross-functional partners in portfolio knowledge, strategic discovery, technical storytelling, executive engagement and complex deal execution, sharing AI Governance expertise where relevant.</li> <li>Maintain accurate opportunity strategy, technical risks, evaluation plans and next steps in Salesforce, in partnership with the account team.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You are a trusted technical and strategic partner on the business’s most consequential opportunities across OneTrust’s solutions portfolio, improving deal progression and technical win outcomes.</li> <li>You build durable alignment across customer executives, practitioners and the OneTrust account team, connecting the right OneTrust solutions to funded priorities and demonstrable business value—including AI Governance where relevant.</li> <li>Your work contributes to healthy ACV growth by helping account teams identify, shape and win the right strategic opportunities.</li> <li>Customers see a credible path from their business priorities to operational outcomes, with connected, secure, scalable and realistic recommendations across the relevant OneTrust solutions.</li> <li>You raise the capability of the wider organisation through thought leadership, repeatable approaches, coaching and actionable customer insight.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You Are</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A strategic, customer-led thinker who starts with outcomes and discovery, navigates ambiguity, and exercises sound judgement rather than defaulting to a product pitch or a standard playbook.</li> <li>Commercially astute: you understand how complex enterprise buying decisions are made, how technical strategy affects deal outcomes, and how to create mutual value without compromising customer trust.</li> <li>An executive-level communicator who can move from technical depth to a concise business narrative, influence senior decision-makers, and adapt to different audiences.</li> <li>A broad portfolio strategist and a credible AI Governance expert, with a strong, current point of view on the AI landscape, associated technologies and fast-moving developments. You continuously assess what is emerging, what is becoming operationally relevant, and what it means for customer needs and OneTrust’s solutions.</li> <li>A technical authority and generous coach: you are a go-to resource on complex problems and actively build the expertise and confidence of others.</li> <li>A cross-functional leader who influences through expertise, brings teams together across geographies, and turns customer and market insight into broader organisational impact.</li> <li>Comfortable setting direction where the answer is not yet established, while being transparent about assumptions, trade-offs, product capabilities and limitations.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your Experience Includes</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, technical sales or a comparable customer-facing enterprise technology role, including a track record of leading complex, strategic opportunities.</li> <li>Demonstrated success shaping strategic sales motions through deep account alignment, executive engagement, multi-threaded discovery and value-based solution design—with evidence of contributing to ACV growth and technical wins.</li> <li>Experience across multiple enterprise solution areas, ideally spanning OneTrust domains such as privacy, AI Governance, data use governance, technology risk and compliance, third-party risk, and consent and preferences. description: We Are Sparta Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders. Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies. Experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success or Account Management — ideally supporting a data, intelligence, or SaaS product. Comfortable using AI and automation tools in your day-to-day work, and curious to find smarter ways of doing things. Strong communicator, comfortable building relationships and influencing stakeholders. Analytical and process-minded — you like understanding what drives client value. Proactive and comfortable with ambiguity — happy to figure things out and get stuck in. High level of integrity and alignment with Sparta's values. Why Join Sparta? At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded. • Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company • $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment • Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale • Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence • Top-tier tools and technology to support your success What's the Culture Like at Sparta? At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers. The Sparta Code Understanding is non-negotiable Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning. The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed. Ask for forgiveness, not for permission Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not. 90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned. Fall in love with the problem The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to. Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working. It's your fault. Lucky you. If it's on you, it's in your control. True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency. Conflict is a gift Honesty is an expression of care. Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it. Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. Most importantly, you’d rather build the right controls once, on our own decisioning platform, than tune vendor defaults forever. What You’ll Own This is a role with a mandate across every rail, product and geo we operate in. See the exposure, everywhere. Design progressive access to payment rails by risk tier, so trusted customers move freely and limits grow with trust. Measure every trade-off. Track each control change in fraud caught against friction added, and retire the rules that no longer earn their place. Protect customers in the moment. Put vulnerable-customer education and in-the-moment verification on every rail, without slowing good customers down. Launch with controls from day one. Make sure every new product, geo or rail has a signed-off exposure map before it goes live. Your calls will shape how fast Aspora can open new corridors, and how safely customers move money once we’re there. Why Aspora Define how Aspora detects and deters fraud across every rail and geo, and set the playbook every launch follows. Work directly with our Head of Financial Crime, and partner with Product, Payments and Engineering on every launch. Build controls on our own decisioning platform, across high-volume cross-border flows at significant scale. Own fraud strategy from day one, from exposure mapping through to customer protection. Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems. Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems. AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them. Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them. Own Technical Direction. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out. Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most. Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size. About You You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team. You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. title: Sales Lead
description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About the role As a Sales Lead at Scarlet you will lead a team of Account Executives in London, grow that team, as well as continue closing deals yourself. You will own your team's quarterly number and the pipeline behind it. Our sales team has grown fast and is about to grow faster so we'll need your help to continue to build the team and develop our talent. You will carry a personal quota alongside your team target, which will be reduced as your team grows, so you stay close to customers and lead from live deals rather than from a dashboard. The deals are technical: you are selling certification to regulatory, quality and clinical leaders at AI and software medical device companies, and you will need to build deep knowledge of EU MDR, ISO 13485 and other medical device certifications. Our best salespeople know the product in depth, and we expect the same of you. You will work day to day with our leadership team, Business Development Reps, Commercial Relations and Customer Experience. This is a full-time, in-office role in London where your team will also be located. You will be in front of customers across the UK and Europe, including at industry conferences and Scarlet-hosted events. Responsibilities Own your team's quarterly target and forecast. Run weekly pipeline reviews, inspect deals, and call commits accurately. Coach AEs on their deals: join discovery and negotiation calls, review call recordings and give feedback, and work with AEs to map decision-makers, budget and signing process on every deal. Hire AEs to grow your team: screen candidates, run interviews, make hiring decisions, and onboard them to set them up for success. Practice what you preach: source, run and close your own deals with regulatory, quality and clinical leaders at AI and software medical device companies. Share what works: write up deal learnings and losses for the wider sales team, and bring improvements to the playbook, qualification and pricing conversations. Work with the BDR team on first-meeting-to-discovery conversion and with Commercial Relations on partner and consultant referrals. Represent Scarlet with your team at industry conferences (for example MEDICA, RSNA) and at Scarlet-hosted events. Required qualifications 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including at least 3 years as a quota-carrying Account Executive owning full-cycle deals At least 1 year managing or formally leading quota-carrying salespeople, with responsibility for their targets A track record of hitting or exceeding quota as an individual contributor, including in the year before you moved into management Experience hiring salespeople: screening, interviewing and making hiring decisions Experience selling a technical or expertise-led product to specialist buyers, with deal cycles of three months or more and multiple stakeholders Experience running pipeline reviews and forecasting a team or territory number to senior leadership Able to show how you have coached an underperforming AE back to target, with the evidence you used Based in, or willing to relocate to, London, with the right to work in the UK Preferred qualifications A STEM degree or equivalent technical background Experience in selling to regulated industries Experience as an early sales hire or first sales manager at a startup, where you helped build the process rather than inherit it Experience selling into European markets outside the UK Compensation and benefits The base salary range for this role is £100,000 – £120,000 per year, with on-target earnings of £200,000 – £240,000. title: Founding Growth Associate
description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We're past product-market fit and growing 2x year on year, almost entirely through word of mouth, Google and AI search. Around 70 new leads land each month without a growth engine behind them, and you'll play a pivotal role in building one alongside the founders. Our co-founder Paddy is taking direct ownership of growth, and he wants a commercially minded builder alongside him: someone who'd rather make the thing than talk about it. You'll sit in the founders' office, working directly with Paddy on whatever moves the number most, from partnerships and events to building something that brings in 50 qualified leads in a month. The goal is 7,000 deals a year. Getting there depends on more of the right people finding us. What you'll build You'll work directly with Paddy , our co-founder, with the freedom to try things fast and the backing to scale what works Growth mechanisms: Lead magnets, micro products, tools and campaigns that bring syndicate leads and fund managers to Odin. You build the actual thing with AI, not a strategy deck about it. Think a calculator every new fund manager bookmarks, or a tool that turns a syndicate lead's first deal into a week's work instead of a month's. Ship it, see what works, double down. Partnerships: Co-investors, syndicate networks, accelerators and fund admins already talk to the people we want to reach. You find the ones who can send us the right people and get them live. Events: Pitch nights, GP-LP mixers and founder dinners for a community that backs everything from AI labs to small nuclear reactors. You'll turn that into new customers. Referrals and repeat: Our existing customers already come back again and again. You'll build the ways they bring others with them. Special projects: The founders' office gets the problems that matter and don't have an owner yet. You'll pick them up, work out what's true and get them done. What we're looking for Exceptionally sharp: At least a couple of years in a role that's trained you to think fast and rigorously. That might be consulting, banking, VC, a founder associate or chief of staff role, or early-stage growth. A commercially minded builder: You love making things, and you think about who they're for and whether they'll move the number before you start. You build with AI: You ship things yourself rather than waiting for someone else to execute your ideas, and you can show us what you've made. Analytical and financially literate: You're comfortable with numbers, you can tell what's working from the data, and you understand how capital moves. Taste and creative flair: You know what will land with a sophisticated audience of investors and founders, and what won't. Fast-moving and self-directed: You make decisions without constant validation and you'd rather ship something today than perfect it next month. Outcomes over activity: Pipeline and revenue are what you optimise for, not impressions or output volume. Credible with investors: Comfortable on a call with a seasoned GP or in a room full of them. Big plus: private markets exposure: VC, angel syndicates or fund admin. Useful, but not required. How we work There are five things we care about deeply: Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to. This role is probably not for you if You want a well-defined lane and a fully built playbook; You'd rather write the strategy than build and ship the thing yourself; You need a team underneath you to get things done; Salary £60,000–£70,000 base, plus bonus and a meaningful equity grant. Hiring process Four stages: an intro call with Imani , our Head of People, a call with Paddy, a 90-minute build task, and a final with our founders. Detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. Location & ways of working We're a London-based team. This role works side by side with the founders, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in person. At least three days a week in the office. Benefits Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total) Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave Compensation: £60K – £70K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • £60K – £70K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Programme Manager
description: About us EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets. The role You will lead our clients through the organisational and operational changes needed to establish a shared AI platform. The platform has two parts: an AI Control Plane that governs what agents may do and records the evidence, and a managed AI Runtime where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services, and both need owners, approval routes and support arrangements on the client side. You will own delivery outcomes from mobilisation through production release and operating handover, acting as the client sponsor's day-to-day counterpart. The role reaches across engineering, business leadership, security, risk, compliance and operations. You will bring these groups together to agree how the platform is governed and supported, and what evidence they need for assurance in a regulated environment. You will lead an EggAI delivery team with a mix of Platform Engineering roles and skills. Client application teams develop the business use cases; you lead AI platform delivery and the changes needed for teams to adopt and operate it. Why this role Most organisations are still working out how to let AI agents act safely in production: who approves what an agent may do, how its actions are evidenced, and who answers when something goes wrong. There is no settled playbook yet, especially in regulated industries. In this role you will help write it. The operating models, approval routes and assurance practices you design with our clients will shape how they run agentic AI for years, and they will become the basis of how EggAI delivers across Europe. You will work at the point where AI capability meets enterprise reality, with direct access to client sponsors and EggAI leadership, and with real influence over how a growing company builds its delivery practice. Responsibilities - Own the delivery plan and milestones, keeping commitments achievable within the agreed scope, budget and team capacity. - Secure the client commitments that delivery depends on. Agree who will provide access, complete service changes and make decisions, then resolve delays with the responsible teams. - Design the target operating model with the client. Define who owns the platform service, maintains policies and software, supports the runtime and approves changes, with agreed escalation routes. - Run milestone acceptance. Submit evidence for each milestone, secure recorded client decisions within agreed review periods and escalate overdue or disputed decisions. - Lead change control with the sponsor and EggAI leadership. Agree scope, capacity, cost and date changes, including proposals for additional services or extended support, before committing the team. - Secure production readiness. Confirm the service owners and funded operating cover from the operating model are in place before go-live, escalating any gap that prevents release. - Lead go-live coordination and the intensive support period after release. Bring client operations and application teams together to resolve incidents and agree when normal support can take over. - Lead platform adoption and training with the technical team, preparing client teams to use shared controls and follow the agreed delivery processes. - Run operating handover through practical exercises. Secure acceptance of ongoing duties and agree any further support needed before the current engagement ends. - Give sponsors a clear account of progress and delivery risks through weekly delivery reviews, regular demonstrations and sponsor reviews. Report spending, forecast work and adoption results so they can make timely decisions. What You Bring - You have led technology programmes into production in a regulated environment, including operational readiness and handover to receiving teams. - You have designed and introduced operating models, turning agreed responsibilities into working approval, support and service-management processes. - You have led delivery across engineering teams, client departments and external partners, including influencing senior sponsors and resolving competing priorities. - You have managed budgets and contractual scope in client delivery, including negotiating changes and shaping additional work. - You understand cloud platforms, security and service operations well enough to challenge plans and dependencies with technical specialists. - You communicate clearly and can lead workshops that turn disagreement or uncertainty into decisions and action. Nice to have Delivery in financial services or banking. AI platforms or agentic AI. Platform engineering, identity, security controls or audit and assurance work. Cloud platform delivery using Azure (preferred), AWS or Google Cloud, and AI platform services such as Microsoft Foundry. German is a strong advantage, as many of our clients are in the DACH region. Practical details - Hybrid working and client-site attendance will depend on the engagement. - You will need to complete the background and security checks required by the client. We'd love to hear from you! If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview. Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.</p> <p>We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.</p> <h2>What You'll Be Doing</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Set the strategy and roadmap</strong> for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.</li> <li><strong>Build one platform for three brands.</strong> Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.</li> <li><strong>Shape our model portfolio</strong> across frontier and open-weight models. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Water practice are looking for experienced Senior Consultants to Senior Managers to join the team.</span> </span></h2> <p>Our Retail, Networks and Water division helps regulated utilities and adjacent organisations improve performance, deliver transformation, and strengthen outcomes for customers. We’re at the heart of these industries, driving meaningful and lasting improvement. </p> <p>This is an incredibly important period for our Water clients. Following final determinations, we expect a sustained period of significant transformation set against the context of rising bills and increasing customer financial vulnerability. As we already work with most of these organisations, Baringa is well positioned to help Water Retailers to successfully plan for and navigate these challenges. </p> <p>Within our Water practice, the Water Retail and Customer Value and Affordability team supports clients to protect their most financially vulnerable customers whilst improving value across the customer lifecycle, with a focus on billing and revenue improvement, debt and affordability, and operational effectiveness in customer-facing functions. </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Helping clients to understand their customers holistically, and how those that are most in need can be supported </li> <li>Work with clients on their major strategic transformation programmes to improve their customer, debt, billing and revenue outcomes through senior strategic advice and thought leadership, data-driven diagnosis, process and journey improvement. </li> <li>Support or lead benchmarking and performance reviews, helping clients understand how they compare to peers and where to prioritise action. </li> <li>Take a leading role in customer and operational transformation programmes, supporting planning, governance, risk management and senior stakeholder engagement. </li> <li>Develop and apply analytical insight, including segmentation, forecasting and KPI reporting, to support better decisions and track impact. </li> <li>Work alongside technology and system change, helping ensure business requirements are clear and operational outcomes are delivered. </li> <li>Contribute to business development, including proposals, client conversations, thought leadership or reusable assets in Water Retail and Customer Value Assurance. </li> <li>You will take on responsibility in line with your experience:  <br> <ul> <li>as a Senior Consultant, owning end‑to‑end workstreams and managing day‑to‑day client delivery </li> <li>as a Manager or Senior Manager, leading workstreams or engagements, managing teams, and taking accountability for outcomes, quality and client relationships </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"> </span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <p><strong>Must Haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working in customer value, debt, billing, revenue assurance or affordability , within water retail  operations, with a solid understanding of the underlying processes, common issues and levers. </li> <li>You’ve supported or delivered billing or revenue improvement initiatives, such as identifying revenue leakage, improving collections performance, or strengthening controls and governance. </li> <li>Experience using data and analysis to diagnose problems, build insight, and support clear recommendations and decisions. </li> <li>You’ve delivered process improvement or operating model work in customer or revenue-focused functions, with an emphasis on practical, implementable change. </li> <li>You will have worked with a range of stakeholders across operations, finance, digital and data teams, and can communicate confidently at different levels of an organisation. </li> <li>You’ve produced clear, structured client-facing outputs, including analysis, slides or written recommendations, with strong attention to quality and narrative. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong> </p> <ul> <li>You’ve contributed to, or led parts of, customer or operational transformation programmes, with exposure to planning, governance, risk management and delivery tracking. </li> <li>Experience working alongside billing, customer relationship management or collections system change, and understand how systems and operations interact. </li> <li>You’ve contributed to proposals, pitches or internal proposition development, helping articulate client problems, solution approaches and description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Enterprise Value Creation practice in London is growing, and we are looking for a Senior Consultant to join the team.</span> </span></h2> <p data-ccp-props="{"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559683":0,"335559685":0,"335559731":0,"335559737":0,"335562764":2,"335562765":1,"335562766":4,"335562767":0,"335562768":4,"335562769":0}"><span data-usefontface="false" data-contrast="none">Expectations of value have changed. title: Senior Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><h1>About the Cash Forecasting team:</h1> <p><strong>Cash Forecasting</strong> is our AI-amplified treasury solution that helps CFOs and treasury teams move beyond error-prone spreadsheets to achieve real-time cash visibility and predictive accuracy.</p> <p>The platform integrates seamlessly with major ERPs and banking systems to automatically capture, categorise, and analyse transactional data across multiple currencies and business units. Leveraging our proprietary GSmart AI technology, the solution continuously learns from historical cash flows, sales data, and treasury information to automatically select optimal forecasting algorithms and improve accuracy by over 30%.</p> <p>You'll work on sophisticated Ruby on Rails and React software that turns diverse financial data into clear analysis, giving customers sharp insight and forecasting through intuitive dashboards. This is a critical platform moving over $100 billion in daily cash flow for enterprise customers across 40+ countries, built to hold enterprise-grade security and scalability at that scale, every single day.</p> <h1>What You’ll Do:</h1> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs that power the Cash Forecasting platform, while remaining comfortable picking up frontend work when the task calls for it</li> <li>Work across a large, sophisticated, multi-tenant SaaS codebase, writing code that's built to scale across enterprise customers and their data</li> <li>Own the data layer, schema design, query performance, and data integrity - with a strong emphasis on PostgreSQL and SQL more broadly</li> <li>Write and maintain thorough test coverage using RSpec, treating testing as a first-class part of delivery</li> <li>Package and deploy services using Docker, and work within our AWS-based cloud infrastructure</li> <li>Write scripts and tooling to automate repetitive work, support data migrations, and keep the team moving quickly</li> <li>Instrument the systems you build with strong observability practices -logging, metrics, and tracing — to catch and resolve issues before they impact customers</li> <li>Benchmark and profile code to identify performance bottlenecks, and make evidence-based decisions about where to optimise</li> <li>Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate business and customer needs into robust technical solutions</li> <li>Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, contributing to the team's overall growth and improvement</li> <li>Be a champion of the YBIYRI ethos (you-build-it-you-run-it), which includes participating in the on-call pager rotation</li> </ul> <h1>What You'll Bring:</h1> <ul> <li>4-8 years of professional software development experience, ideally including full-stack work with a backend lean</li> <li>Strong SQL fundamentals; hands-on experience with PostgreSQL ideal</li> <li>Comfortable working within large, sophisticated, existing codebases and making changes safely</li> <li>Scripting ability for automation and tooling (language-agnostic)</li> <li>Experience with Docker or other containerisation technologies</li> <li>Proven Git proficiency, including collaborative branching workflows</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Ruby, Python, or Java)</li> <li>Experience employing AI tools throughout the development lifecycle to speed up problem-solving and delivery</li> <li>Experience testing with RSpec</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred Knowledge / Experience:</h1> <ul> <li>Experience with Ruby or Ruby on Rails is a strong plus - while we value the ability to learn quickly across languages, familiarity with our primary stack will help you ramp up faster.</li> <li>Frontend experience, ideally with React, and the ability to contribute there when needed</li> <li>Experience with, or solid understanding of, AWS</li> <li>Experience building or maintaining multi-tenant, enterprise SaaS platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with observability tooling and practices (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting)</li> <li>Experience benchmarking and profiling code for performance</li> <li>Experience in the financial industry, particularly treasury, payments, FX, or ERP systems</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Do Your Best Work</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: title: Support Trainer - EMEA
company: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
description: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. 👋 As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Role Requirements Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. You Should Apply If: You're excited about iterating on a strong program foundation and thinking creatively about enabling Support on highly technical topics. You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging. You want to stay close to the frontline work you're training people to do, not just design programs from a distance. You're data-driven and want to tie training effectiveness to real performance and customer outcomes. You love coaching people and watching them grow into confident, capable support professionals. You May Not Want to Apply If: You'd rather focus solely on individual coaching than program design and materials development. You prefer not to spend regular time handling Support tickets to stay connected to the work. You're not interested in balancing program-building with hands-on training delivery. You're uncomfortable iterating on training programs based on feedback and changing product needs. About Ashby Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com . About Go To Market We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us: We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell. title: Staff Engineer - Telematics
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations. The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale. This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction. What you will do Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution. Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop. Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product. Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time. Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows. Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently. About the role: In this role, you will: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team What you will bring A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve. Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work. Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way. Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth. Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners. Experience that could be useful Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential. What success looks like Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. title: Staff Data Analyst, Marketing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p><strong>THE IDEAL CANDIDATE</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>The ideal candidate is a self-starter and problem-solver, skilled at leveraging technology and data to deliver top-tier analytics solutions. They thrive on addressing complex business challenges and are consistently effective in making high-judgment decisions at a rapid pace, even in the face of ambiguity and uncharted scenarios. Additionally, the ideal candidate is energized by a work environment where strategy, innovation, and decision-making are intentionally distributed, where transparency, agility, and data-driven insights are highly valued, and where colleagues at all levels hold each other to exceptionally high standards to serve Quince customers.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the US team to understand what exists that we need to replicate and the gaps that we need to build upon</li> <li>Develop and maintain automated reports to track Marketing KPIs:</li> <ul> <li>New/Returning Customers, LTV/CAC, Total vs. inc. ROAS</li> <li>Performance Marketing Channel: Paid Social, SEM, App, Affiliates etc.</li> <li>CRM: Customer cohort, Database health + Lifecycle stages</li> </ul> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Conduct ad-hoc analyses to identify channel inefficiencies, scaling opportunities, areas for improving MER / Total ROAS.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering and Performance team to deliver experimentation and incrementality studies: Geo-Lift tests, Channel Incrementality, Brand lift, MMM validation. </li> <li>Partner with product, engineering and CRM to deliver:</li> <ul> <li>A data driven customer lifecycle programme including key drivers of high-value customers </li> <li>A/B and multivariate tests across lifecycle touchpoints that optimize revenue per visit, and Incremental LTV / Revenue</li> <li>A multi-category approach to cross selling, identifying triggers and next best actions based on customer behaviour</li> </ul> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Implement data quality, governance (inc. GDPR) and AI usage best practices in collaboration with the US. </li> <li>Be an integral part of the international team and contribute to their growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or similar).
