Strong Excel skills and experience with Xero or a similar accounting system. A proactive approach, with the confidence to investigate issues rather than simply flagging them. At least two years' experience working in industry rather than solely in practice. Experience of timesheet-based, multi-client billing and credit control. title: Principal Software Engineer
description: Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance. It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job. You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets. What you'll do at UiPath Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products. Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working. Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't. Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads. Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements. Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us. Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it. Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough. What you'll bring to the team A solid track record (7+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on. Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all. Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written. Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems. Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months. An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents. A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook. Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust. Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive. An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us. You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart. The team The Risk Squad owns credit risk and fraud for iwocaPay, iwoca's Buy Now Pay Later product for businesses. The aim is to lend to every business likely to repay, and to spot the ones that aren't. The squad works across three areas: Lending decisions. Building and improving the automated credit model. The portfolio. Tracking losses, chargebacks, and seller performance, and deciding which segments to grow or pull back from. New products. Designing the risk side of each one before it launches. The squad is small and new – two data scientists, a risk analyst and a risk lead. The role As a Data Scientist in the Risk Squad, you'll co-own every credit model with the other data scientist and review one another's work. The job is mostly supervised ML on tabular data, with a fair amount of data engineering as the squad moves onto its own pipelines. You'll start on the automated credit model and take on the invoice financing models over time. You can also test ideas with iwoca's other lending data science teams, who work on similar credit problems. You'll choose what to work on and write the plans you deliver. Much of the squad's work happens in iwocaPay's product and strategy meetings, so your models shape the roadmap. You'll also help set up how the squad works – what it monitors, and the guidelines it follows. Live project examples: Model architecture. Rethinking the model around how iwocaPay actually lends: overlapping facilities, short terms, and a growing set of products a customer can use. Blending datasets. Bringing more iwocaPay-specific data into the models while still drawing on iwoca's larger core lending dataset, through methods such as transfer learning. Invoice financing. Building a credit risk model from scratch for a new product on a segment iwoca hasn’t lent to before. Plus finding the modelling opportunities elsewhere in the funnel, like in our offers... The requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Production ML. You have built supervised ML models on tabular data end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring. Ownership. You work well in a small, early-stage team where priorities move quickly. You build what you need as you go, and take loosely defined problems from framing to a landed decision. Judgement. You know when a model is good enough to go live, and when it needs more work. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a modelling pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in product, risk, and leadership. Bonus: Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk modelling or lending. Non-linear methods. You have used gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production. Combining datasets. You have used transfer learning, domain adaptation, or similar methods on data sources of different size and relevance. Data engineering. You have built data pipelines and managed datasets alongside your modelling work. Coding. You can write code for analysis. The squad works in Python. The salary We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. title: Senior Business Operations Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><h2><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></h2> <p>The Chief Business Officer organization drives company-wide growth and global expansion. </p> <p>This is the role that turns Airbnb's ambition for the UKI & Nordics into a plan and holds the organisation to delivering it: shaping strategy, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving sustainable commercial growth across one of our most important regions.</p> <p>This includes recruiting and supporting high-quality Stays, Experiences, and Services, alongside executing Airbnb’s global market strategy. Shaping business approaches, quality supply sourcing, and international growth efforts are integral to the team’s success in connecting millions more hosts and guests to Airbnb's platform.</p> <h2><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h2> <p>You will join the UKI, Nordics, Middle East and Africa team, covering one of Airbnb’s largest and most mature markets alongside five of Europe’s most digitally advanced, high-trust travel markets. The UK offers scale, brand strength, and a sophisticated regulatory environment; the Nordics offer strong domestic travel behaviour and significant headroom for growth. Together they make this one of the most commercially interesting regions in EMEA to build in.</p> <h2><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h2> <p>You will own the business operations agenda for the UKI and Nordics. Airbnb’s most established European market alongside five high-potential Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). Partnering closely with the Country Manager, you will set the regional growth strategy, translate it into a plan cross-functional teams can execute against, and run the operating rhythm that keeps it on track. This is a high-visibility role: your influence will come from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilise teams to grow further.</p> <h3><strong>Regional growth strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the UKI & Nordics growth strategy end to end: define where the region should compete, what it should stop doing, and the handful of bets that will move guest nights, supply growth, and revenue.</li> <li>Build the annual and quarterly plan with the Country Manager, sizing opportunities and making explicit recommendations on where to deploy marketing spend, supply investment, and partnership effort.</li> <li>Set and pressure-test the region’s targets, translating global goals into market-level commitments that supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product teams can own.</li> <li>Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out.</li> <li>Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays.</li> <li>Build the case for investment in the region: sizing, business case, and the socialisation needed to win resource in global planning cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operating rhythm and execution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the region’s operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, so leadership has a single, trusted view of performance and the story behind it.</li> <li>Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product.</li> <li>Track delivery against the plan, surfacing risks and bottlenecks early and driving them to resolution rather than escalating them.</li> <li>Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed.</li> <li>Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-functional leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the connective tissue between the UKI & Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support.</li> <li>Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities.</li> <li>Build alignment on high-priority projects, market launches, and product tests, brokering trade-offs between global consistency and local market reality.</li> <li>Represent UKI & Nordics in NEMEA and global business operations forums, and bring the best of what other markets are doing back into the region.</li> <li>Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Insights and storytelling</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached.</li> <li>Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst.</li> <li>Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.</li> <li>Champion data-driven decision-making, and use AI tooling to compress the time from question to insight. Automating recurring analysis and reporting so the team spends its time on judgement, not assembly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h2> <p>To deliver in this role, Airbnb is seeking candidates with:</p> <ul> <li>12+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting, or commercial leadership, with a track record of owning outcomes in a market or business unit</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to set strategy and drive it through to execution </li> <li>Deep experience influencing without authority across a global matrixed organisation</li> <li>Strong analytical toolkit; comfortable working with finance and data science partners and interrogating the numbers yourself</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication, with executive presence in front of senior leadership</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, and a strong bias toward action and ownership</li> <li>Practical fluency with AI tools and a view on where they change how a team operates</li> <li>Familiarity with the UKI and/or Nordic markets, or comparable mature-market experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Additional</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in a two-sided marketplace, travel/hospitality, or consumer tech</li> <li>Experience launching or scaling new products or lines of business in-market</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>This role will require to be in the London office 3 days per week. </strong></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£126,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£158,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Flow Flow Engineering is an AI-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor. About the role Flow is seeking software engineers to build AI-powered capabilities that help teams author, review, and manage requirements more effectively. title: Research Scientist - Control & Machine Learning
description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? Research questions you could initially work on Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control? Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected? Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics? Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site? These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next. Your main responsibilities As a Research Scientist, you’ll: Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems. Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems. Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works. Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms. Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production. Follow deployed performance, investigate failures, and use what you learn to guide further research. Communicate your findings clearly and contribute to the team’s scientific understanding. What a great fit looks like A PhD in control, machine learning, applied mathematics, engineering, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience. A strong research background in one or more of control theory, data-driven control, system identification, Bayesian optimisation, probabilistic modelling, physics-informed machine learning, imitation learning or model-based reinforcement learning . Evidence that you can formulate a research question, develop a method and evaluate it carefully, through publications, open-source work or applied research. Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch. An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice. Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms. A strong interest in climate mitigation. You don’t need to know about cement. You do need to get excited about the physics, willing to learn from operators and process engineers, and keen to understand why a plant behaves the way it does. We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring depth in a relevant area and these problems excite you, we’d like to hear from you. In return for your hard work, we’ll give you 📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside. 🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team. 🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge 🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one. Our Operating Principles ↗️ Go Gig or Go Home : High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires. 🏭 Concrete Honesty : Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture. 🦾 Autonomous Ownership : High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it. 😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun : Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page. title: Senior eCommerce Content Strategist
description: About Us Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms. Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development. The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C. The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption. A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms. The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility. Tasks What You’ll Be Doing Content Audits & Quality Assessment ● Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short. ● Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. ● Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy. Content Strategy Development ● Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus. ● Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour. ● Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category. ● Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on. ● Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction. AI & Agentic Discoverability ● AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search. ● Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations. ● Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery. Testing & Performance Monitoring ● A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent. ● Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation. ● Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy. Creative Briefing & Review ● Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and marketplace advertising content. ● Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction. ● Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery. Client Management ● Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders. ● Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams. ● Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements. ● Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice. ● Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business. Quality & Output Review ● Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements. ● Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy. AI-Enabled Working ● AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy. ● Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team. Requirements What You Bring to the Role ● Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment. ● Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C. ● Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards. ● Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy. ● Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers. ● Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results. ● Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this. ● Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals. ● Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats. ● Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle. ● Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance. ● Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers. Desirable ● Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms. ● Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive. ● Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals. ● Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base. Benefits What We Offer ● Competitive salary and benefits ● Hybrid Working Model ● Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team ● Continuous learning & career development ● The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a full-stack Product Engineer * to lead the inception and development of our internal application suite, serving as the foundational architect for the tools our world-class researchers use every day. *Note that you would be joining as a ‘Member of Technical Staff’, but the indicative job title above hopefully helps to explain the nature of this role. The role will be part of our Platform Engineering organisation. Your Impact In this role you will be building the internal product ecosystem that streamlines and curates our proprietary discovery workflows, which is critical for accelerating our mission to solve global challenges through next-generation materials. Your main focus initially will be partnering with our VP of Product to define and build the first generation of internal applications from scratch, ensuring they are not just functional but curated as high-quality products. Over time, you will likely get involved in scaling these systems to support increasingly complex interdisciplinary data flows and potentially external-facing interfaces as our "search engine" for materials evolves. What You Will Do Product Inception & Internal Tooling Lead the development of a suite of internal applications, treating them as first-class products with a focus on usability and long-term scalability. Collaborate closely with the VP of Product to translate high-level research needs into technical roadmaps and intuitive software solutions. Own the end-to-end lifecycle of internal tools, from initial architecture and backend design to frontend deployment. Full-Stack Development & Platform Integration Design and build robust backend services in Python to interface with our core AI and research engines, integrating disparate workflows into a unified, high-performance internal platform. Partner with the Data Engineering team to ensure seamless ingestion and visualisation of complex datasets within internal applications. Develop clean, responsive UIs that enable researchers to interact with complex data effectively, maintaining a high bar for intuitiveness and reducing cognitive load for technical users. Interdisciplinary Collaboration Work closely with AI Researchers and Data Engineers to understand the nuances of their daily tasks and build tools that empower them. Collaborate with the broader engineering team to ensure internal tools align with our overall infrastructure and security standards. Must Have Skills and Qualifications: You have at least 4+ years of professional experience in full-stack software engineering, with a proven track record of building and maintaining production-grade applications. You possess strong backend expertise, specifically with Python and modern web frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Django, or Flask). You are proficient with Node.js and modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React, Vue, or TypeScript) and have a keen eye for UI/UX best practices. You are a "builder" at heart who enjoys the greenfield stage of a project and is comfortable making architectural decisions from scratch. You have a product-focused mindset, meaning you don't just "write tickets" but actively think about how to make the user's life easier. You are excited by the prospect of enabling world-changing scientific discovery, even if you don't have a background in the sciences yourself. Bonus Points (But Not Critical): Experience working in an early-stage startup environment where you've had to wear multiple hats. Previous experience building internal tools, dashboards, or "Admin" interfaces for data-heavy companies. Knowledge of modern DevOps practices and cloud infrastructure (e.g. GCP, Docker, Kubernetes). An academic background or personal interest in Materials Science, Chemistry, or Sustainability. Additional Considerations This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work. What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. title: People Operations Partner
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🚀 The Role We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team. tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Core People operations needs more firepower as we scale, and there's a direct commercial angle too: a strong People Operations function is what lets new joiners ramp up and become productive faster once they arrive. This is a multi-disciplinary People Operations role at the centre of the employee lifecycle - equal parts operational delivery, automation and continuous improvement. You'll be the reliable hands keeping People processes running as we scale, from multi-country payroll to onboarding, employee changes and offboarding. You'll also build the tools, automations and lightweight AI workflows that connect our systems (Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n and Google Workspace), so the function doesn't need to double in size every time headcount does. In your first 12 months, you might: Take ownership of payroll across our UK and employer-of-record employees, keeping every cycle accurate and on time as pay schedules and countries multiply. Become the trusted point of contact for employees and managers, owning their queries through to resolution. Build the automations and AI-enabled workflows that remove repetitive manual work from the employee lifecycle. Turn recurring pain points into better processes, tools or self-service, and measure whether they actually worked. Move across People disciplines as priorities shift - reward and benchmarking, pensions and options administration, performance cycles, engagement and people data. 🛠️ Responsibilities Run payroll end to end: own monthly payroll across UK and employer-of-record employees - changes, corrections, off-cycle and ex-gratia payments, contractor payroll and invoicing, and country-specific items - keeping it accurate and on time as we add pay schedules and countries. Keep the lifecycle running: deliver core People operations across onboarding, employee changes, contracts and documentation, leave, mobility (visas and international moves), EOR and contractor setup, and offboarding, flexing into whatever the business needs most. Be the trusted point of contact: own employee and manager queries through to resolution with a clear response standard, rather than passing them between functions. Keep the foundations accurate: maintain employee data, documentation and systems so that everything else can depend on them. Automate the repeatable: build and maintain automations and lightweight AI-enabled tools, workflows and agents that connect Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n, Google Workspace and similar, and remove repetitive manual work - with controls so speed never costs accuracy, privacy or employee trust. Own the People tech stack: evolve our People technology ecosystem - evaluate emerging tools, consolidate where we can, and simplify the architecture. Improve continuously: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, measure whether they worked, and give foundational People processes a named owner and a runbook someone else could follow cold. Design to delight and to scale: we treat our people like top athletes and aim to delight at every step of the employee journey, and what works at today's size shouldn't need twice the People team when headcount doubles - default to eliminating or automating work rather than administering it. Partner across the business: work with Finance, Legal, Talent, Performance Partners and functional specialists to turn People initiatives into scalable services, and build dashboards and lightweight analysis that help the team and the business make better decisions. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves You've worked in People Operations, People Services, HR Operations or another operational People role - generalists welcome - and you hold a high bar on accuracy and confidentiality. You've run payroll cycles end to end, ideally multi-country, in-house or through an employer of record. UK fundamentals (PAYE, RTI, pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments) are familiar, or clearly learnable fast if your payroll experience comes from another market. You're highly comfortable with technology: AI is part of how you work, you actively experiment with new tools and capabilities, and you can build automations through no-code or low-code tools, integrations and AI workflows. You think in systems and workflows rather than individual tasks, with a strong instinct for simplification ("why are we doing this manually?"), and you're comfortable using data to diagnose problems and make decisions. You operate effectively in ambiguity, without waiting for a perfectly defined process or remit, and you balance efficiency with empathy - People Operations is about people, not just workflows. Strong ownership instincts: when something's broken, unclear or inefficient, your instinct is to fix it, and you're willing to move across People disciplines depending on where the organisation needs you. Desirable Breadth across the People remit beyond Operations - reward and benchmarking, pensions, benefits, or performance and engagement. This role is deliberately multi-disciplinary. Familiarity with the basics of UK and EU employment law, and experience administering equity or share options (for example EMI or unapproved schemes, and cap-table tools such as Vestd). Experience supporting international employment through employers of record, and setting up or managing contractors (including off-payroll and IR35 awareness). Experience in a fast-scaling startup or scale-up, especially through a period of doubling headcount or entering new countries. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. title: Engineering Manager, Experiment Platform, Robot Software
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model. The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software. 🧠 Your day-to-day You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track. You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns. You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches. Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration. Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes. Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases. Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability. Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands. 🙌 You should apply if: You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management. You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field. You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers. You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability. You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer. You care about operational reliability and release quality. Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. This role is based in our London office. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews : leadership and management interview, and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total Deep-dive interviews : domain, systems design and code review interviews; 3 hours total Final interview : values alignment (30-45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. title: Unix Platform Engineer
description: <p><strong>Department Overview:</strong></p> <p>Our Technology Infrastructure team operates globally and is responsible for every aspect of the firm's hybrid platform. This ranges from our EUC/Office environments to Trading and Core service Co-Location Data Centres, and extends to Public Cloud, delivering top-tier technology services to a dynamic and demanding Trading organisation.<br><br>In addition to meeting the round-the-clock operational demands of the platforms, we continuously evolve and transform our platforms to maintain a competitive edge that our business requires. We innovate to provide valuable solutions and leverage our skilled Technology teams to deliver against rapidly changing business requirements.</p> <p><strong>Role Overview: </strong></p> <p>As a member of our London-based Infrastructure Platform Engineering team, this position encompasses the design, engineering, and support of our multi-tenant private and public cloud initiatives. The role is integral to delivering services to our core business sectors globally, including Trading, middle and back office, and Technology.</p> <p>The role is responsible for the support and maintenance of the BlueCrest Linux estate and Automation Services, delivered via On-Premise, Colo and Public Cloud platforms, providing robust solutions based on leading technologies to enhance and support our business.</p> <p>The role delivers excellent levels of service to the business, requiring an understanding of key business processes and a solid understanding of how the solutions we deliver aid and develop our growing business. The successful candidate will understand and be involved in critical BAU and technology service delivery activities in a time-sensitive environment, whilst being innovative and implementing new solutions to enhance business performance.</p> <p>The successful candidate will follow pre-defined scopes, designs and plans to assist in implementing and supporting new and existing technology initiatives, while demonstrating clear communication skills.</p> <p><strong>Experience required: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive knowledge and experience of a major Linux Enterprise Server distribution including installation, configuration, automation, administration, and support in diverse, highly dynamic, fast-paced environments - desirable: <ul> <li>SUSE Certified Administrator/Engineer (SCA/SCE), Red Hat Certified System Administrator/Engineer (RHCSA/RHCE), or equivalent Linux certification.</li> <li>Experience with container platforms and tooling, including Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and GitOps, is also desirable.</li> <li>Knowledge of integrating Linux within a Windows environment, including Active Directory and Kerberos integration.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience designing and supporting low-latency Unix-based trading systems in exchange colocation data centres.</li> <li>Experience of automating and orchestrating cross-platform services using tools such as Terraform, Terragrunt, and Cloud-Init.</li> <li>Advanced scripting/programming skills in Python and Bash, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and data structures such as JSON and YAML – highly desirable.</li> <li>Experience of server hardware implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and automation using Infrastructure as Code and Ansible, including deployment and support within colocation facilities, low-latency environments, and distributed trading platforms.</li> <li>Experience supporting on-premises infrastructure, integrating it with cloud platforms, and ensuring resilience, performance, and scalability across hybrid environments.</li> <li>Experience with AI/ML workloads, AIOps, and supporting infrastructure would be beneficial.</li> <li>Technology-focused and committed to continuous learning, with the ability to deliver rapidly while balancing business constraints in fast-paced enterprise trading environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate is an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with proven hands-on experience supporting enterprise Linux platforms, with strong expertise in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).  The role requires experience integrating hosted and on-premises systems, with a focus on standardisation, automation and orchestration to deliver scalable, reliable infrastructure solutions. Experience supporting cloud platforms and AI/ML workloads would be beneficial.</p> <p>This role would suit an enthusiastic, self-motivated individual who thrives in a pressurised environment and wants to develop their Linux and automation skills and knowledge whilst gaining a detailed understanding of business processes.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>BlueCrest is committed to providing an inclusive environment for its workforce. As an employer, we provide equal opportunities to all people regardless of their gender, marital or civil partnership status, race, religion or ethnicity, disability, age, sexual orientation or nationality. </em></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Director, EMEA
description: Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle. At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary. Sales Director, EMEA This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading. As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success. Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing. Responsibilities Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers. Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one. Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities. Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition. Manage and grow an existing book of business in partnership with Account Management, driving retention, expansion and executive-level relationships. Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product and Engineering to advance deals and make sure client commitments are accurate and deliverable. Capture and communicate client and market insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market strategy. Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce. Act as a senior Talos presence in the London market, representing Talos at industry conferences and client events. Share expertise and informally mentor junior members of the sales team. Requirements 7+ years of client-facing sales or commercial experience within institutional financial services, fintech or enterprise SaaS serving capital markets. An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe. A proven track record of originating and closing new business, with quantifiable results. Deep understanding of TradFi market structure and institutional trading workflows. Experience in FX, fixed income, equities or multi-asset trading environments is highly valued. Familiarity with digital assets is advantageous but not required. You should bring genuine interest in how TradFi is adopting digital assets and tokenization. The ability to lead consultative, senior-level sales conversations and explain complex infrastructure in clear, client-friendly terms. Strong commercial judgment, with the discipline to set realistic client expectations and avoid overcommitting on product or timelines. A self-directed, high-ownership approach: you can build a pipeline and maintain momentum independently, without ramp-up or close guidance. A collaborative, team-first mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, distributed environment with a high degree of autonomy. Based in London, or able to work from the London office. Our Sales Approach Talos operates a systematic, consultative sales process built around a simple principle: listen first, sell second . We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't. We maintain a balanced pipeline across focus segments, use Salesforce rigorously to track progress, and hand off every closed deal with a documented account plan so the relationship starts on solid footing from day one. We play the long game. Underpromise, overdeliver, and build the kind of relationships that compound over time. More about Talos Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture! Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024 Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company." Benefits You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include: Retirement plan contributions Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus. title: Head of Brand and Creative
description: Head of Brand and Creative The Role The UK is Lyrebird's most important new market, and you'll own how we show up in it. You'll co-develop Lyrebird's brand strategy and lead its rollout across the UK, covering media, communications, campaigns, research, partnerships, agency and budget management, and the brand measurement that proves it's working. You'll also own the creative bar for everything Lyrebird makes globally. That means the taste and quality of the work, plus the operations, agencies and systems that let in-house and external teams produce world-class creative at pace. This is a senior leadership hire at a foundational moment: you'll shape how Lyrebird looks, sounds and feels as it scales. This role suits someone who moves easily between thinking about the brand and the category and caring about the quality of a single frame. You'll enjoy setting strategy in one meeting and art-directing in the next. You get as much energy from building the system behind great work as from making it, and you can hold a room of executives as comfortably as a room of creatives. If you want real influence over business outcomes and a brand you can call your own, you'll feel at home here. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians' most time-consuming tasks. We're building the medical intelligence layer for modern healthcare: a clinical AI platform that combines ambient real-time documentation, intelligent document management, clinical workflow automation, native patient data integrations across siloed health systems, and a communications layer that keeps clinicians and patients connected. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We give clinicians richer patient information at the right moment and lighten their mental load during consults, so they can focus on delivering better care. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. What you'll do Co-own Lyrebird's brand strategy and lead its UK rollout. This covers positioning, media, communications and campaigns that grow brand preference and trust among UK clinicians and healthcare professionals. Set and hold the creative quality and taste bar for everything Lyrebird makes globally, whether it's made in-house or by agencies. Build the creative engine: the operations, workflows, playbooks and systems that let in-house and external teams produce world-class work at volume and pace. Select, brief and manage creative and media agencies to a high standard, and decide what we build in-house and what we outsource. Design and own a brand measurement framework for a clinical audience, and report on brand health against clear goals. Shape the research and partnerships agenda that helps build the medical AI category the right way. Work closely with growth, retention, product marketing, our clinical team, product and engineering, analytics, sales, customer success and our founders, so the brand holds together across every touchpoint. What you'll bring Senior experience leading brand strategy and creative output, either at an agency or in-house at a growth-stage company, and a body of work you're proud of. A high creative bar. You set the standard, art-direct, and give sharp direction that lifts the quality of a team's work. Operational brand media depth: planning, buying and optimising integrated campaigns across digital, OOH, streaming audio, social, professional media partnerships, conference sponsorships and sponsored content. Creative operations and agency leadership. You've built the systems and managed the partners that let great work ship at pace. An audience-first instinct backed by analytical rigour. You turn insight about a professional audience into positioning, media and creative that resonate, and you're comfortable with brand measurement, including brand lift and incrementality. Strong leadership and communication, and an AI-native approach. You build and develop talent, and you use AI across creative development, planning, research and reporting. Nice to have Familiarity with healthcare or medical audience channels, such as medical associations, clinical publications and conference media. Experience in the UK or NHS healthcare market. Comfort with dashboards and marketing measurement tools such as Tableau, Sigma or Looker, and with marketing mix modelling or incrementality studies. The work you do here will shape how clinicians first come to know and trust Lyrebird, and that trust is what lets them bring it into the care they give. The stronger the brand and the work, the more clinicians reach for Lyrebird, and the more patients feel the difference. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you're from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Accounts Payable Associate
description: LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South. Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live. What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth. With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity. About the role LemFi is the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve - powering cross-border payments, multi-currency accounts, savings, and credit across 21 countries. Our Finance team sits at the centre of all of it, and the AP function is what keeps the engine running cleanly behind the scenes. As an Accounts Payable Associate you'll own the end-to-end processing of vendor payments across our UK, US, Canada, Ireland, Norway, Nigeria, and other entities - working across multiple currencies, GL codes, tax jurisdictions, and approval chains. You'll work closely with the wider Finance, Growth, and Operations teams, and you'll have real scope to improve the processes you inherit, not just execute them. What you'll build and own Process and control vendor invoices across multiple entities and currencies in Tipalti and NetSuite - accurately, on time, every time Perform first-line GL coding, cost-centre allocation, and tax coding (VAT, reverse charge, RCS), flagging anomalies before they become problems Run and support payment cycles - validating bank details, currency, and approval sign-off - and manage the AP inbox with clear, prompt communication to vendors and internal stakeholders Own the monthly AP close: accruals, aged payables review, and reconciliations, with discrepancies surfaced and resolved, not buried Maintain vendor master data (bank details, tax status, W-9/W-8 forms) with tight controls, and support audit requests with clean, well-organised evidence Spot recurring miscoding, duplicate invoices, and process gaps - then help fix them, contributing to automation initiatives (including n8n workflows and NetSuite automation) that reduce manual effort for the whole team Support bank statement uploads and reconciliations for the Reporting team, ensuring transactions post correctly and discrepancies are flagged fast Your experience 1-3 years in an Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, or transactional finance role Hands-on experience with an AP or ERP system; NetSuite and/or Tipalti strongly preferred Comfortable processing across multiple currencies and entities; exposure to a multi-jurisdiction or group structure is a real advantage Working knowledge of VAT and sales tax concepts - reverse charge, non-deductible VAT, or equivalent Strong Excel skills: lookups, pivot tables, data cleanup, and reconciliation work Detail-oriented and control-conscious, with the ability to prioritise a high volume of transactions and meet payment deadlines without dropping the ball Clear written communicator who can liaise confidently with vendors and internal stakeholders Nice to have Experience in a fintech, payments, or regulated financial services environment Exposure to automation tools (e.g. n8n) or light scripting for finance workflows Experience supporting external audit requests (KPMG, Crowe, BKL, or similar) Why Join LemFi? Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this. At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions. You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play . Recruitment Agencies Notice LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.
