title: Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer, Apps Platform
description: <p>Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer, Apps Platform, London</p> <p> </p> <p>As an Infrastructure Engineer on the Apps Platform Infrastructure team, you'll help build and evolve our platform’s deployment and observability layers across multiple cloud providers and on-premises, for both internal and customer-managed environments. This is a role for someone who cares about building cloud-agnostic infrastructure and deployment pipelines.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with internal teams to understand how they use and deploy the platform, debug their issues, and shape a roadmap that balances immediate needs with long-term architecture.</p> <h3>You will:</h3> <ul> <li>Expand the deployment footprint of our platform to cover both on-premise, all major cloud platforms and beyond</li> <li>Ensure fast, secure, and reproducible deployments across all supported CSPs and on-prem  </li> <li>Expand the observability of the platform so that forward deployed infrastructure teams can easily and efficiently operate customer deployments</li> <li>Partner closely with internal teams deploying the platform to understand their needs, debug issues, and build tooling that serves their use cases</li> <li>Respond to incidents and production issues with urgency, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive fixes</li> <li>Help develop and maintain a product roadmap for deployment and observability</li> <li>Lead architecture reviews and own projects end-to-end, from design through deployment, in fast-paced cross-functional settings</li> </ul> <h3>Ideally you'd have:</h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience building and deploying enterprise and public sector solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and on-premises</li> <li>Deep expertise in infrastructure design, networking engineering, VPNs, load balancers, and firewalls</li> <li>Deep proficiency with IaC, containerisation and orchestration tools and technologies (Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker)</li> <li>Comprehensive understanding of CI/CD pipelines and software delivery principles using GitHub Actions or CircleCI.</li> <li>Experience with GitOps-style deployments and a track record of ensuring consistent, repeatable deployments</li> <li>Strong debugging skills and the ability to navigate performance/security tradeoffs in production systems</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to context-switch between reactive incident work and proactive product development</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to haves:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience as a founder or early engineer at an infrastructure-focused startup, owning a product end-to-end</li> <li>Experience running secure workloads in multi-tenant or untrusted environments (e.g., FaaS, CI sandboxes, remote notebooks)</li> <li>Open-source contributions to systems or developer-tools projects</li> <li>History of on-call/incident response for production systems</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE: </em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, </em><em>Ernst</em><em> </em><em>&</em><em> Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. </em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. title: Data and AI Engineer Director | Market Lead
description: <div class="description content"> <p><strong>Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI</strong></p> <br> <p><strong>Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI</strong> · Director level · London preferred</p> <p>We are looking for a Director-level Market Lead to head our Data & AI practice in the UK & Ireland. This is a hybrid leadership role. You combine deep technical solutioning with real commercial skill, and you are credible both in an architecture debate and across the table from a CDO, CIO or CFO.</p> <p> Our delivery model is shifting from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first pods working against a business outcome. As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. We are developing these ways of working together.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Main focus and responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Commercial and solutioning</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive commercial success on complex Data & AI deals across UKI, from shaping the opportunity through to a signed deal. This includes structuring fixed-price and outcome-linked commercial models, and understanding delivery cost, margin and risk.</li> <li>Partner with tech advisory and industry domain leads from pre-sale through delivery, so the commercial story, the architecture and the sector insight reinforce one another.</li> <li>Frame and test business-outcome hypotheses with executives, and define thin slices of delivery that prove value quickly.</li> <li>You stay close enough to delivery to know what is realistic, and you share accountability for outcomes on the deals you sell.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Practice leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spearhead growth of the UKI Data & AI practice: build, lead, scale and mentor a high-performing team.</li> <li>Work with delivery and talent leads to match demand with capacity, so the right people and pods are available when deals land. Keep specialist skills sourced and bench waste low.</li> <li>Shift the practice's capability mix towards production AI engineering and agentic delivery, through hiring, reskilling and role-based onboarding.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage executive-level relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CISOs and other CXOs. Act as a sparring partner on AI strategy: challenge assumptions, size the opportunity, and help clients decide where agentic automation and AI can move the P&L.</li> <li>Build and manage robust sales pipelines and lead strategic client workshops.</li> <li>Advise clients on responsible AI, covering risk, governance and regulatory expectations in the UK and wider markets.</li> <li>Expected to lead and drive P&L with TCV of 50 -75 M GBP and ACV of 45-50 M GBP/</li> <li>Expected experience and capabilities in driving all P&L criterias including sales, margin, utilization, bench management, training, learning, partnership based sales etc.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>I</strong><strong>deal candidate profile</strong></p> <p>The successful candidate is a true dual-threat practitioner, equally at home in a complex architecture discussion and in closing a large commercial deal.</p> <br> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Criterion</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Requirement</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Experience</p> </td> <td> <p>Significant senior experience in data and AI consulting, typically 15+ years, with a track record in leadership roles. You are neither a pure solution architect nor a pure sales profile.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Commercial track record</p> </td> <td> <p>History of selling multiple large-scale data and AI deals, ideally including recent GenAI or agentic engagements, and able to discuss deal shape, pricing structure, trade-offs and delivery and business value delivery in concrete terms.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Technical expertise</p> </td> <td> <p>Strong solutioning background in complex ecosystems: data platforms and data products, data governance, and AI systems in production, including agentic and LLM-based systems. You understand failure modes, evaluation, cost and risk, not just architecture diagrams.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Data/AI balance</p> </td> <td> <p>Roughly 70/30, with demonstrable recent depth in AI (last 2–4 years), for example AI agents, AI advisory or AI foundations with large UK clients. We appreciate people who think independently, use evidence to guide their decisions, and take responsibility for what they deliver. This position combines hands-on execution with real ownership. You will have the trust and freedom to make decisions, question existing approaches, and directly influence business growth. At our scale, even incremental improvements can have a significant commercial impact. Experience working within an in-house e-commerce team is essential. We will not consider candidates whose Google Ads background is primarily in agency, consultancy, or freelance work. We are seeking someone who has owned performance from inside an e-commerce business, where success is assessed through revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and sustainable growth. You should be ready to take responsibility for commercial outcomes and implement your own decisions, with involvement that extends beyond providing recommendations or delivering campaigns. What we are looking for: A minimum of 2 years of practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns A track record of owning Google Ads performance within an e-commerce business, with direct accountability for results and profitability Thorough working knowledge of Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns Proven experience as part of an in-house e-commerce team Confidence working with large datasets and extracting insights that inform practical action A sound understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center Strong analytical thinking and careful attention to detail Fluent written and spoken English The ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced setting where priorities can change An inquisitive, proactive mindset and a consistent focus on improvement The confidence to make decisions independently and accept responsibility for the results An openness to using AI and automation as we continue expanding their application across the business Availability to join immediately or at the earliest possible opportunity How you approach your work: You combine senior-level judgment with a practical approach to execution. Your decisions are grounded in data, and you know how to translate analysis into concrete steps. You actively look for opportunities to improve, remain curious about what drives performance, and keep commercial outcomes in focus. You are comfortable moving between strategic planning and daily campaign management, with a strong motivation to build and scale. Location and travel: We are investing further in London and anticipate that it will play a growing role as one of our business hubs. Our broader team is based across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. You will also travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, or other team locations. These trips bring colleagues together for planning, workshops, team events, and strategic discussions. As we grow, we continue to value regular time together in person alongside the flexibility of remote work. Our culture: At ennovationHUB, we value: Taking ownership and being accountable for outcomes Putting ideas into practice Communicating clearly and directly Developing knowledge through hands-on experience We welcome colleagues from a wide range of backgrounds who take pride in their work, accept responsibility, and want to help the business move forward. This is a long-term opportunity to play a meaningful part in the continued growth of an international e-commerce group. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h2> <p>CoreWeave’s Global Tax Team’s mission is to mitigate risk, drive operational efficiencies, and add financial value by combining technical expertise with a proactive, collaborative approach to global taxation. We are seeking a Senior Manager, International Tax Operations, to join our team. This role will be crucial in managing international tax operations, including income tax compliance and provision. It is a unique opportunity to share and influence global tax strategies at a rapidly growing technology company.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>Within our AI native Tax Department, this high-impact London-based role offers significant opportunities. You will play a part in influencing our global tax strategy and operations across EMEA and APAC. Reporting to the Director of Tax Operations, you will manage international tax matters in a fast-paced regulatory and business environment. You will partner with the Global Tax team (direct tax operations, advisory and controversy, indirect tax), Controllership and business operations counterparts, and external advisors to ensure compliance and deliver the company’s direct tax compliance and reporting.</p> <ul> <li>Compliance and provision</li> <ul> <li>Manage non-US direct tax filings prepared by internal teams and external advisors, including matters related to Pillar 2</li> <li>Advising on local income tax compliance and other reporting obligation matters including DAC 6, anti-hybrid regulations, CbCr, etc. </li> <li>Partner with Controllership in the preparation of statutory financial statements, including the calculation of statutory tax provisions and advise on income tax reporting </li> <li>Enhancing internal controls to ensure accurate accounting for income taxes</li> <li>Building up and liaising with external tax service providers and external auditors in the region on our co-sourcing engagement across tax and statutorily financial statements</li> <li>Co-lead with Director of Tax Operations the build out of APAC provision and compliance processes in 2027, whilst remaining focused on the expansion of EMEA</li> <li>Partnering with indirect tax team on various matters including entity expansion, and indirect tax impacts of intercompany transactions</li> <li>Partner with Treasury to support global cash management</li> <li>Develop and leverage AI tools to enhance and streamline income tax reporting and provision processes</li> </ul> </ul> <ul> <li>Advisory Support</li> <ul> <li>Support local management in the integration of M&A targets into CoreWeave</li> <li>Provide support and management of ex-US income tax controversy</li> <li>Look for tax opportunities via our co-sourcing relationships (i.e. non-US R&D credits, withholding tax relief, etc.) </li> <li>Stay abreast of international and OECD legislative and statutory tax changes that may impact  CoreWeaveProvide guidance on international tax topics </li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>ACA, CA, CTA, ACCA or comparable corporate tax and accounting knowledge  </li> <li>10+ years of progressive corporate tax experience in public accounting and multinational companies.</li> <li>Solid technical tax knowledge across EMEA and APAC.</li> <li>Experience in managing global projects</li> <li>Strong leadership, analytical, and communication skills with executive presence.</li> <ul> <li>Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills</li> </ul> <li>Interest in building with new technology and automation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</strong> </p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. </p> <ul> <li>You love to understand the “why” behind business operations</li> <li>You’re curious about tax regulations and their business implications and expanding your knowledge of tax developments</li> <li>You’re an expert in translating complex tax concepts into actionable business guidance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong><strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong><strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong><strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. title: Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. </strong></p> <p><strong>We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. </strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.</strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. </strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>For more information, visit <a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwpp.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7CErica.Durr%40wpp.com%7C9bf4566a65bc46a48ac008de749116ea%7C150b5e663d884dee83f6ed149b727a00%7C0%7C0%7C639076363668176216%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Q9juosud56XGLThSFZ1NpPZd6FXpJPxV74OeRZWoh%2B4%3D&reserved=0" target="_blank">WPP.com.</a></strong><br><strong> </strong></p></div><h1>About WPP</h1> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.</p> <h1>About the Role</h1> <p>The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.</p> <p>Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.</p> <h1>Why This Role Matters</h1> <p>WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.</p> <h1>What You’ll Do</h1> <h2>Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability</h2> <ul> <li>Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.</li> <li>Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.</li> <li>Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.</li> <li>Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.</li> <li>Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.</li> </ul> <h2>Enable strategic workforce planning</h2> <ul> <li>Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.</li> <li>Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.</li> <li>Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.</li> <li>Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.</li> </ul> <h2>Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support</h2> <ul> <li>Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.</li> <li>Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.</li> <li>Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.</li> <li>Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.</li> </ul> <h2>Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions</h2> <ul> <li>Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.</li> <li>Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.</li> <li>Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.</li> <li>Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Scale tools, capability and adoption</h2> <ul> <li>Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.</li> <li>Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.</li> <li>Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.</li> <li>Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.</li> <li>Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.</li> </ul> <h1>Minimum Qualifications</h1> <ul> <li>Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.</li> <li>Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.</li> <li>Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.</li> <li>Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex organisation.</li> <li>AI fluency, including a practical understanding of how AI and automation can improve analytics, workforce planning and decision support, and how they may reshape work, skills, roles and workforce requirements.</li> <li>Experience leading and developing an analytics or reporting team, including setting priorities, assuring quality and building capability across locations.</li> <li>A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred Experience</h1> <ul> <li>Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.</li> <li>Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise transformation or significant workforce change.</li> <li>Proficiency with relevant business intelligence, data-visualisation or analytical tools, which may include Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R.</li> <li>Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.</li> </ul> <h1>What Success Looks Like</h1> <ul> <li>A clear enterprise workforce-intelligence proposition focused on the workforce and organisation decisions most critical to One WPP and Elevate28.</li> <li>A more integrated and trusted data foundation, with common definitions, practical governance and decision-support tools that connect workforce, organisation, business and financial insight.</li> <li>Workforce plans, scenarios and recommendations that materially improve decisions about skills, capacity, location, cost, AI and automation, technology and workforce shape.</li&

These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Find a balance between your internship and life outside work</li> <li><strong>5 days of annual leave:</strong> Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship</li> <li><strong>Life in the office:</strong> Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista</li> <li><strong>Learning and development:</strong> Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation.</li> <li>Guiding customers through Monzo’s business banking offerings - providing clear, factual information and helping them evaluate what works best.</li> <li>Being a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services.</li> <li>Managing a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking.</li> <li>Driving activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up, onboarded, and are using Monzo for their banking needs.</li> <li>Collaborating internally: work closely with marketing, product, risk and customer operations to ensure a smooth journey for customers.</li> <li>Delivering outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieving sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.</li> <li>Feeding insights back: capture and share customer feedback — customer pain points, required features, suggestions for product improvements.</li> <li>Adapting & iterate: Things will change rapidly and often - you’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity and change and help support what comes next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have experience in Small Business sales, ideally selling business solutions or financial services; knowing how to engage business customers and understand their mindset, needs and pain points.</li> <li>Have a proven track record of meeting (or exceeding) sales quotas / targets in a performance-driven environment.</li> <li>Are an expert at managing a full sales cycle: from prospecting to activation, including structured and rigorous outreach and follow-ups and cross-team coordination.</li> <li>Have high emotional intelligence and are able to quickly connect and build a relationship with customers of diverse backgrounds and levels of knowledge.</li> <li>Are a strategic communicator,  excellent at building trust and helping customers discover value - you’re consultative, you listen, you ask insightful questions.</li> <li>Are adaptable and resilient, you embrace change and have a strong winning mindset to see challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.</li> <li>Can communicate clearly: written, verbal, via video; you simplify complex topics for customers.</li> <li>Are coachable and comfortable seeking constructive criticism to empower continuous learning and improvement</li> <li>Are comfortable working in a fast-moving, high change environment. You thrive when things aren’t fully defined yet.</li> <li>Can demonstrate high levels of personal organisation: tracking your pipeline, managing your time, prioritising your leads and follow-up tasks.</li> <li>Have integrity and strong consumer duty awareness: regulatory compliance, knowing your customer, reducing risk, safeguarding data and ensuring we put consumer duty first are foundational to this role and our culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice-to-haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience in a regulated environment (banking)</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Familiarity with SMBs in specific verticals (e.g. food & drink, professional services, construction)</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍 4 days a week in our London office but with occasional flexibility to work remotely (in the UK)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Analysis</li> <li>Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. title: Accounts Payable Clerk
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team. </p> <p>Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/P ledgers, process supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, prepare supplier payments, deal with queries effectively and efficiently and maintain compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development including offering you with support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <h3><strong>A day in the life of an Accounts Payable Clerk</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/P ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our vendor data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of vendor data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Prepare our supplier payments in line with the payments timetable and presented for approval in a clear and organised format</li> <li>Identify payments properly withheld, monitored and released when approval given</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: prepayments, accruals, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will bring to the role</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, look ups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organisation skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an exterprise level accounting system </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li>Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Product Director, Flex (Borrowing)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London / UK | Salary dependent on experience + Stock Options + Benefits </p> <p>Flex is one of Monzo’s fastest-growing and most commercially significant products. Four years ago, we reinvented the credit card experience—building something simpler, more transparent, and genuinely useful. Today, over a million customers use Flex.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Director to lead Flex into its next phase of growth.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, deeply commercial role at the intersection of product and credit. You’ll define how we scale borrowing responsibly, expand into new segments, and continue building products customers genuinely love.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with Engineering, Credit, Data, Design, and senior leadership to identify new opportunities, optimise performance across complex segments, and deliver at pace.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on… </strong></p> <p><strong>Set the strategy for Flex</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set direction for one of Monzo’s most important revenue-driving products</li> <li>Identify and unlock new commercial opportunities across customer segments</li> <li>Navigate complex trade-offs between growth, risk, and customer outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive commercial performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Credit teams to shape propositions across multiple risk segments and cohorts</li> <li>Interrogate performance deeply — from unit economics to long-term profitability curves</li> <li>Identify and drive new commercial opportunities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Champion the customer</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure Flex remains rooted in strong customer outcomes, not just revenue</li> <li>Push for simple, transparent, and delightful experiences</li> <li>Advocate for customer experience alongside commercial outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build and lead a high-performing team</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage and develop a team of Product Managers</li> <li>Deliver multiple high-impact initiatives through your direct reports</li> <li>Raise the bar on product thinking and foster a culture of high standard and high velocity</li> </ul> <p><strong>🌟 What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <p><strong>Commercial Thinking </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong commercial instinct — you think in terms of trade-offs, economics, and outcomes</li> <li>Comfortable operating in complex environments (e.g. multiple segments and cohorts with different commercials)</li> <li>Able to engage deeply with Credit and Data partners</li> <li>Experience in lending, credit cards, or adjacent borrowing products </li> </ul> <p><strong>Consumer Focus</strong></p> <ul> <li>You start with the customer never lose track of their needs</li> <li>You’re willing to challenge revenue-driven decisions when they conflict with good customer outcomes</li> <li>You have strong product taste and care deeply about experience quality</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & Leadership </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced environments with multiple workstreams</li> <li>Comfortable going deep in the detail while leading through others</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership across technical, credit, and governance stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p> <p><strong>#LI-AC1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS2</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. designing commercials for business cases and negotiating with partners. </li> <li>Presenting your ideas and working across a number of stakeholders including engineering, legal, risk management, product, strategy or marketing.</li> <li>Designing and building new processes for effective decision making as Monzo continues to scale up.</li> <li>Supporting the build of a highly competent and motivated team of financial analysts with clear objectives for ongoing development to partner with existing and new businesses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you..</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have demonstrable experience in financial business partnering with senior business leaders- driving commercial, revenue generating projects, evaluating business cases and influencing decisions.</li> <li>Are comfortable navigating highly complex fields of financial services, with the ability to break down problems into manageable chunks and working through them. </li> <li>Hold strong financial modelling (advanced Excel/Google Sheets) experience, preferably you are also comfortable pulling your own data using SQL/Python.</li> <li>Have great analytical & problem solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, issues and recommend actions.</li> <li>Hold good interpersonal & influencing skills, ability to engage across various internal functions to develop, get buy-in and deliver outcomes across teams</li> <li>Have experience building business cases, presenting and debating investment choices</li> <li>Demonstrate ability to be hands-on and enjoy supporting colleagues, projects or tasks both big or small</li> <li>Have strong attention to detail and organisational skills, able to support with developing new processes and streamlining existing processes to create efficiencies</li> <li>Have a background in retail banking; an understanding of credit is preferred. You will closely use NPV and ROE frameworks to drive profitable strategy.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £84,200 - £99,000 + incentive awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office, with a hybrid working environment. We're open to distributed working within the UK, with the expectation of at least once a week in our London office.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps:<br><br></strong><strong>- Phone call with recruiter (30mins)<br></strong><strong>- Video call with finance team member (30 mins)<br></strong><strong>- Video call with hiring manager (45 min)<br></strong><strong>- Video call with stakeholder (30 mins)</strong></p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-NZ1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Senior Product Director, Business Banking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. This is a rare opportunity to shape one of Monzo’s most strategically important product areas, leading teams to build innovative, differentiated experiences that no other bank offers.</p> <p>You’ll set the long-term vision, craft a customer-obsessed strategy, and create the execution engine that turns ambition into reality. We’re looking for someone who pairs exceptional product taste with strong analytical depth, thrives in ambiguity, and can inspire multiple teams to deliver world-class outcomes.</p> <p>If you’re excited by the idea of redefining business banking for millions of customers—and building high-performing teams along the way—this role puts you at the heart of Monzo’s next chapter.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on:</strong></p> <p>As the Senior Product Director for Business Banking, you will define and drive the product strategy, vision, and execution for one of Monzo’s most strategically important product areas. You’ll craft an ambitious roadmap rooted in deep customer insight, emerging market dynamics, and commercial impact—setting a vision that differentiates Monzo in the business banking space.</p> <p>This role is a rare blend of strategic thinking, world-class product taste, analytical depth, and an ability to consistently ship great work. You will cultivate a high-performance, ownership-driven culture across multiple product teams, guiding them to innovate, execute, and scale products that meaningfully improve the financial lives of our business customers.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Product Strategy & Vision</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set a bold, customer-centric, commercially grounded product strategy for Business Banking.</li> <li>Develop and articulate a compelling long-term product vision that positions Monzo as the leader in differentiated business financial experiences.</li> <li>Combine customer insights, market trends, and commercial priorities into a roadmap that delivers measurable business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation & Differentiation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foster a culture of innovation that challenges conventions and inspires teams to build category-defining experiences.</li> <li>Identify and pursue opportunities to meaningfully differentiate Monzo’s business banking offerings.</li> <li>Drive teams to create unique, delightful products based on exceptional product taste.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Analytical & Strategic Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spar with data scientists and use data to understand “the why” behind customer behaviour, product performance, and opportunities.</li> <li>Help teams deepen their analytical thinking, improving decision-making quality across the org.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & High-Performance Culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build an execution engine that consistently delivers against ambitious goals.</li> <li>Create extreme clarity on priorities, establish strong processes, remove blockers, and maintain team momentum.</li> <li>Instil a culture of ownership, speed, and high performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership & Organisational Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a self-starter with a strong bias for action—willing to lead from the front when needed and empower from behind when that’s best.</li> <li>Take full ownership of the Business Banking product area, operating with autonomy and accountability.</li> <li>Identify organisational inefficiencies and design structures that enable teams to thrive.</li> <li>Hire, coach, and develop exceptional product managers, helping them reach their full potential and cultivating the next generation of Monzo product leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a seasoned product leader, and have a track record of leading high-performing product teams at a fast-growing consumer tech company to:</li> <ul> <li>build highly engaging (daily/weekly) experiences for millions of customers</li> <li>deliver company trajectory-changing impact</li> <li>(nice-to-have) build a multi-market product, with a proven ability to balance priorities across geographies</li> </ul> <li>You're data-driven and commercial, and have a track record of collaborating with data scientists to define key metrics, run experiments, and deliver business impact.</li> <li>You can systematically break down and solve complex problems.</li> <li>You have good judgement, and you’re able to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”. </li> <li>You have the urge and resilience to challenge the status quo and make things better, and are full of creative ideas for how to do so.</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles - spanning engineering, design, data, user research, marketing, legal and compliance - to get stuff done.</li> <li>You’re a great storyteller, who is able to motivate, energise and inspire people towards a common goal.</li> <li>You’re passionate about building value for customers and not just achieving business results, and are excited about our mission at Monzo.</li> <li>You’re intellectually honest about your work's performance, continually striving for improvement. </li> <li>You’re a fast learner, humble and curious, and enjoy learning every day and sharing your knowledge and experience.</li> <li>You’ve managed a team of PMs, have a proven ability to coach and develop others, and can provide clear and constructive feedback to your team and other disciplines.</li> <li>You can get hands-on when necessary, to fill gaps - in people or experience - and set a practical example for what great looks like.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role. This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Global Payroll Manager
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>Global Payroll Manager</strong>, ideally a candidate who thrives on building scalable systems, automating manual processes, and creating operational excellence in a high growth technology environment. </p> <p>We are looking for a leader who combines deep payroll expertise with a systems oriented mindset. You should be passionate about process improvement, automation, and leveraging technology to increase accuracy, efficiency, transparency, and employee satisfaction. Experience supporting a remote, international workforce is highly valued, as is a genuine interest in the software and technology industry.</p> <p>This is a management position which requires confidence in setting direction, driving excellence, managing priorities, developing team members, and communicating effectively with stakeholders across the business. As we continue to grow globally, you will play a key role in scaling our payroll infrastructure and raising the standard for operational excellence. This role will report to the Global Financial Controller.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. </p> <p><strong>The role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with HR, Accounting, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Financial Planning & Analysis, and external payroll providers to support payroll operations and compliance</li> <li>Manage end-to-end payroll operations across different countries, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing</li> <li>Review, validate, and approve payrolls prior to final processing</li> <li>Establish and maintain strong payroll controls to ensure data accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency</li> <li>Perform payroll and salary cost analyses, investigating and explaining variances</li> <li>Ensure compliance with all applicable payroll tax, statutory, reporting, and employment-related requirements across jurisdictions </li> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll-related audits, coordinating responses to internal and external audit requests</li> <li>Monitor legislative and regulatory changes that may impact payroll processes, controls, or compliance obligations</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance payroll accuracy, scalability, and the employee experience</li> <li>Continue to develop, document, and maintain payroll policies, procedures, and internal controls</li> <li>Maintain strong relationships with payroll vendors and service providers, ensuring service levels and deliverables are met</li> <li>Incorporate industry best practices, emerging technology, including AI, to improve reporting quality, efficiency, and accuracy</li> <li>Lead, mentor and coach a team of global payroll professionals</li> <li>Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements while identifying and managing compliance risks.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Accounting or Finance, or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path</li> <li>Significant payroll experience supporting multi-country and/or global payroll operations</li> <li>Strong knowledge of payroll compliance, taxation, and internal controls</li> <li>Experience managing payroll audits and regulatory requirements</li> <li>Proficiency with payroll systems, HRIS platforms, and spreadsheet-based analysis</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills</li> <li>Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship</li> <li>The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues</li> <li>A track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity,
